purpose: Define an exception-aware, explicitly non-canonical research presentation policy for HeartFetter Lv4/Lv7 job-specific effects without treating ConditionParam as a universal activation/display job.

policy.defaultRule: For a research projection row not listed in explicitOverrides, retain the row's ConditionParam JobInfo reference as presentationJobId only because the current full-population source diagnostic confirms that job name appears in at least one linked Skill/Buff source description.

completionCriteria: All 1,158 tracked research rows map exactly once.
Exactly 1,154 rows use the validated default rule.
Exactly four Ainz rows use explicit ID-keyed overrides.
Every mapped presentation JobInfo ID belongs to the same frozen hero explicit job set.
The four override presentation jobs are exactly the jobs named by both current Skill and Buff source descriptions.
No canonical or production-consumer field is introduced.
reopenConditions: The tracked research projection or source-description diagnostic changes.
A post-HeartFetter runtime evaluator resolves the exact ConditionType=7 predicate.
A source/contract/schema change invalidates the four explicit Ainz overrides.
completion: An explicit exception-aware research presentation policy is frozen: 1,154 validated default rows plus four ID-keyed Ainz overrides, with no canonical or production semantic promotion.
